g.text: Forecast demand and supplier risk - A trained model, not a rule - this is the only place AI is required
Recommend an action per family - Turns the forecast into an action inside the bands Finance agreed
Report last month's accuracy - Descriptive - what happened?
Explain the biggest deviations - Diagnostic - why did it happen?
Forecast demand and supplier risk - Predictive - what will happen?
Recommend an action per family - Prescriptive - what should we do?
Set the budget limits and bands - Finance sets the limit up front, so no finished plan is ever rejected
Report last month's accuracy - Automated, so the accuracy review can no longer be skipped
Check each action against its band - Only exceptions reach a person; everything in band runs through
Approve or change, and record why - Nothing can be changed without a recorded reason
Where the missing measurements get taken
Report last month's accuracy - Forecast accuracy (MAPE) and bias - both missing today (D1)
Approve or change, and record why - Override rate and reason mix - not measurable at all before now
Order materials and schedule production - Stockout rate, and OTIF counted against the released plan
